model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for six different language families across six distinct models. The horizontal axis represents language family, with categories labeled “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “IE-other”, “Isolate”, “Semitic”, and “Uralic”, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “effect”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5.  For each language family, there are six bars representing different models: “mBERT-L2” (light green), “XLM-L2” (light blue), “mBERT-R2” (red), “XLM-R2” (dark blue), “mBERT-B2” (coral), and “XLM-B2” (teal). Each bar includes an error bar extending above and below its upper and lower bounds. The height of the bars varies considerably, with the tallest bars observed in the “IE-Germanic” category reaching approximately 24-26 for most models and shorter bars in the “Isolate” and “Uralic” categories, with heights generally under 8. The bars are grouped by language family, and within each group, the models are in a consistent order. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
